description.ja: マウス脳の光子計数 microCT・脳血管ラベル付き（{mb}）
description.en: Photon-counting micro-CT of a mouse brain with cerebrovascular labels ({mb})

credit.name: Huang Siyi / Han Xin / Li Zuoyan / Zhou Enze / Wang Shaoyang / Liu Qian / Xie Tianwu

changes.ja: 元の NIfTI 形式データ（total_whole_brain、頭蓋含み全脳のトータルエネルギー像）を頭部範囲に切り出して DICOM に変換し、スライス方向を 670 枚から 512 枚にリサンプル（間隔 0.02292 mm → 0.02999 mm）。同梱の脳血管マスク（vessel_mask）をそのまま造影セグメントに、頭蓋内像（total_intracranial）のサポート領域から血管分を差し引いたものを軟部組織セグメント（脳）として登録し、本アプリで3D再構成。格納値は光子計数CTの処理値で、HUには較正されていない
changes.en: Converted from the original NIfTI data (total_whole_brain, the total-energy whole-brain image including the skull): cropped to the head and resampled along the slice axis from 670 to 512 slices (spacing 0.02292 mm -> 0.02999 mm), then written as DICOM. The bundled vessel mask (vessel_mask) is registered as-is on the contrast segment, and the support region of the intracranial image (total_intracranial) minus the vessels is registered as the soft-tissue (brain) segment; 3D reconstruction and rendering in this app. Stored values are photon-counting CT processed values, not calibrated Hounsfield units
